description: This file defines the InvokableMethodProxyBase class, which models the proxy base for an invokable method within the Orleans code generator. It includes properties for the code generator, proxy base type, extension status, alias components, and invokable base types, along with equality and string representation methods.

classes.name: InvokableMethodProxyBase
classes.description: Models the proxy base for an invokable method, including its type, extension status, alias components, and associated invokable base types.

methods.name: InvokableMethodProxyBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the proxy base with a code generator, descriptor, and invokable base types.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another InvokableMethodProxyBase instance based on the Key property.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the Key property.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Key.
